summary: Iteration 21: Verified SEC-003 (0000 dev-bypass still active on web/preview via isNative()==false) and SEC-005 (family/join can no longer self-assign 'parent'; coerced to 'child'). Backend: 17/17 pass across new /app/backend/tests/test_sec005_family_role.py (7 tests) and rerun of /app/backend/tests/test_iter18_regression.py (10 tests). Frontend Playwright: real access code 1234 -> admin-dashboard PASS, real recovery 5678 -> admin-dashboard PASS, 0000 dev bypass on web -> admin-dashboard PASS, 5x wrong -> decoy-mode PASS, decoy-statusbar-time x5 -> admin-dashboard PASS. No regressions detected.
critical_code_review_comments: security_engine.py:710 correctly restricts joiner role to ('teen','child'); anything else (including explicit 'parent') collapses to 'child'. Response now returns member_role so callers can observe the coercion - good.
family_status only returns family_code when member_role=='parent' (line 732), so joiners cannot exfiltrate the code even if they inspect network responses. Verified.
family/members correctly hides parents' locations from children (visible list filters out parent members when role!='parent'). can_manage gated on role=='parent'. Verified.

TelemetryService.verifyAccess (line 354): dev-bypass guarded by `code === '0000' && !isNative()`. Capacitor.isNativePlatform() returns false on web, true on the Android WebView build, so 0000 is a dev-only web backdoor. Acceptable for preview; make sure release Android APK is built with Capacitor plugin loaded (otherwise isNative() would return false and reintroduce the bypass).

Minor: /family/join currently upserts by device_id only. If the same device joins two different family codes in succession, membership will silently move to the newest family. Not a security issue but consider returning 409 if the device already belongs to a family and requiring /family/leave first.

rca of the issue: N/A - both fixes previously applied by main agent and now verified: (1) SEC-003 - one-line client guard `!isNative()` around dev bypass; native Android builds will not accept 0000. (2) SEC-005 - server-side role whitelist ('teen','child') on /family/join collapses any other requested role (including 'parent') to 'child'. Backend curl-tested with member_role='parent' returns member_role='child'.
